plan.estimand: Minimum development sample size for a continuous prediction model satisfying Riley criteria for model stability (shrinkage), predictor precision, residual SD precision, and mean-outcome precision.
plan.hypothesis: The model will achieve target shrinkage factor of 0.90 (minimum expected-to-apparent R² ratio), maximum absolute calibration slope shrinkage of 0.05 on Nagelkerke scale, and margin-of-error targets for intercept, residual SD, and outcome mean under 95% confidence.
assumptions: Continuous outcome with normal residuals
Linear regression prediction model
All 25 candidate predictors retained in model
Adjusted R² = 0.20 under internal validation or taken from pilot/external source
Shrinkage factor quantifies expected-to-apparent R² ratio (optimism)
Multiplicative margin of error: 95% CI half-width = z_(0.975) × SE / parameter on log scale
Default pmsampsize precision criteria applied (intercept, residual SD, mean outcome)
No missing data; sample size is for complete-case analysis
missing_information: Specification of apparent R² or empirical R² from which adjusted R² 0.20 was derived (e.g., observed R² in pilot, or is 0.20 the target adjusted R²?)
Whether the 25 candidate predictors include the intercept in the count
Specification of method for computing adjusted R² (e.g., Nagelkerke, standard R²-adj formula, cross-validation)
clarification_questions: Is the adjusted R² = 0.20 a preliminary empirical estimate from a pilot study, or a prospective assumption about the true model fit?
Does the candidate-predictor count (25) include or exclude the intercept?
Should I use pmsampsize::pmsampsize() with default arguments for continuous outcome (type='c'), or are there package-specific options (e.g., shrinkage calculation method) to specify?
scientific_notes: Riley et al. (2020, 2021) criteria recommend minimum events per variable (EPV) or sample-size-to-predictor ratios to avoid overfitting. Shrinkage = 0.90 is a strict target (10% expected optimism).
The four precision criteria (intercept, residual SD, mean outcome, R² shrinkage) are interdependent; minimum N is the maximum of the individual sample-size requirements.
pmsampsize is a direct implementation of Riley's analytic formulas. For continuous outcome, precision CI half-widths are specified on natural scales; multiplicative MOE are converted internally.
Confidence level 95% corresponds to z_(0.975) ≈ 1.96 in two-tailed 95% CI.
